scripts.build: cd retired/backend && bun run build && cd ../../apps/web && bun run build && cargo build --release -p solace-notifications
scripts.dev: cd retired/backend && bun run dev & cd apps/web && bun run dev & cargo run -p solace-notifications
scripts.lint: bun run check:rules && cd retired/backend && bun run lint && cd ../../apps/web && bun run lint && cd ../native-calendar && bun run lint && cd ../native-mail && bun run lint && cd ../../packages/native-core && bun run lint
scripts.lint:react-doctor: bun run --cwd apps/web lint:react-doctor && bun run --cwd packages/ui lint:react-doctor
scripts.typecheck: cd retired/backend && bun run typecheck && cd ../../apps/web && bun run typecheck
scripts.typecheck:native: cd packages/native-core && bun run typecheck && cd ../../apps/native-calendar && bun run typecheck && cd ../native-mail && bun run typecheck
scripts.test:native: cd packages/native-core && bun run test && cd ../../apps/native-calendar && bun run test && cd ../native-mail && bun run test
